events.title: Ships and seafarers increasingly caught in the crossfire of unrelated wars
events.summary: The global shipping industry is facing a "genuinely unprecedented" convergence of maritime crises, with vessels and seafarers increasingly used as “leverage” in conflicts that have nothing to do with them.

events.title: UN chief demands Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon amid Nabatieh escalation
events.summary: The Secretary-General has condemned mounting civilian casualties in southern Lebanon and called on Israel to withdraw its forces from Lebanese territory, as fighting intensifies in and around Nabatieh.

events.title: Syria’s transition hinges on justice for all, UN Human Rights Council hears
events.summary: A successful and lasting transition in Syria requires comprehensive accountability, inclusion and guarantees that violations will not be repeated, UN independent investigators told the Human Rights Council in Geneva on Tuesday.
